Throw Events

General Concept: Throw Events in BPMN are elements that trigger or propagate events during process execution, such as End Events and Intermediate Throw Events. These elements ensure correct event creation, variable mapping, and process control for all throw event types.

  • End Event
  • Intermediate Throw Event

Usage & Options in TaktX:
Throw Events in TaktX:

  • Trigger outbound actions such as messages, errors, escalations, or signals during process execution.
  • Support output variable mapping using FEEL expressions to prepare event data.
  • Enable process control, interruption, or notification based on event type.
  • Provide error handling and compensation for advanced process control.
  • Allow monitoring and audit logging of event creation and propagation.
  • Can be used for process completion, notifications, or control flow changes.
